entities.summary: Divisional-General Donatien-Marie-Joseph de Vimeur, vicomte de Rochambeau was a French Army officer and colonial administrator who served in the American Revolutionary War and French Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars. He was the son of Jean-Baptiste Donatien de Vimeur, comte de Rochambeau.
